title: console: a refused self-registration shows the server's raw English message — RegisterPage maps only USER_ALREADY_EXISTS to localized text
body:
## Symptom

On a zh-CN console, submitting `/_console/register` with an uninvited email on a stock boot (audience posture `invite_only`) shows this verbatim under the Chinese form:

> Self-registration is closed on this environment (audience posture invite_only). Ask an administrator for an invitation.

The text is English and exposes the internal term "audience posture invite_only" to an end user.

## Mechanism

The server answers `403` with a stable code, `{"code":"SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED", ...}`. The same door can also answer `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` under the `email_domain` posture.

`apps/console/src/pages/auth/RegisterPage.tsx` passes an error-code map to the form that localizes only `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS` and `USER_ALREADY_EXISTS_USE_ANOTHER_EMAIL` (`auth.register.errors.userExists`). Every other code falls through to the server's `message`.

## Reproduction

1. Boot a stock objectstack showcase with an owner already created (objectui pin `dd3f7e1be356`).
2. Open `/_console/register` signed out, with the console locale `zh`.
3. Register `someone@example.com`, a new email with no invitation.
4. The refusal renders the English server message above.

## Expected

`SELF_REGISTRATION_CLOSED` and `EMAIL_DOMAIN_NOT_ALLOWED` map to localized, end-user wording, for example 「本环境未开放自助注册,请联系管理员获取邀请」. The raw server message is reserved for codes the page does not know.
